query: SELECT id AS "id!: VfAccountId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND (id < $3) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND ($3 IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2) __ids ORDER BY id DESC
